instruction: Use one arm to place the box of playingcards in the basket with handle.

Directly interact with the plastic switch with angled edges

Grab the the mouse with two buttons and wheel and position it onto the Gray mat.
Take the ceramic bowl with earthy brown trim, place it, and stack the blue bowl on top.
Grab the plastic seal with handle and press Beige
Position red block, green block, and blue block in the center and stack blue block on green block, followed by green block on red block.
Use the left arm to move the white bottle with orange label to the pad

Catch the smooth brown bottle with green label, then grab the smooth plastic bottle too.
Take the white microphone handle black accents and move it to the other hand.

Bring large block, medium block, and small block to the center, sorting largest to smallest.

Grab the first the bowl with shiny texture, position the second, then add the third.

With both arms, move two the white shoe with rubber sole into the shoe-box with Nike printed logo, tips facing left.

Activate the door to open the countertop microwave.
Center red block using the left arm, then stack green block with the left arm on top.
Use the medium-sized metal hammer to hammer the block.
With the right arm, pick the barcode scanner, then grab the cube tea box with embossed designs with the left arm, and scan the cube tea box with embossed designs.

Pick up red block using the left arm, set it on the left, repeat the placement with the right arm for green block, and the left arm for blue block.

Lift and open the laptop with black textured screen.
